title: lincoln · described

turns.text: Make one image, aspect 1:1, from this exact description: Create a photorealistic colour photograph of a man in his mid-fifties, translating an antique monochrome studio portrait into restrained, lifelike colour. Frame vertically from mid-chest upward, shoulders nearly square, head upright and almost frontal, subtly turned toward the viewer’s left. His long, narrow, asymmetrical face has a high, broad forehead crossed by several deep horizontal wrinkles, prominent cheekbones, hollow cheeks, and a tapering jaw. Fair, weathered skin shows pores, fine creases, pronounced under-eye bags, crow’s-feet, and deep folds running from nose to mouth. Thick, dark, irregular eyebrows overhang deep-set, light grey eyes looking directly toward the camera. The nose is long and prominent, with a broad, rounded tip and defined nostrils. Closed, uneven lips form a firm, unsmiling line, the lower lip fuller. A coarse dark-brown beard, lightly streaked with grey, follows the cheeks and jaw and covers the chin; leave the upper lip clean-shaven. Dark-brown hair, greying in strands, is short around the ears, longer and loosely waved above, side-parted and swept across the crown. Dress him in an 1860s black wool coat, waistcoat, white high-collared shirt, and broad, loosely tied black bow tie. Use directional, moderately soft upper-left lighting, gentle shadows, a plain grey backdrop, fine archival grain, and sharply detailed facial texture.
